class Student:
    def __init__(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        self._mentor = None

    def setNumber(self, aNumber):
        self._number = aNumber
        return True

    def getNumber(self):
        return self._number

    def getMentor(self):
        return self._mentor

    def hasMentor(self):
        return self._mentor is not None

    def setMentor(self, aMentor):
        existingMentor = self._mentor
        if existingMentor is None:
            if aMentor is None or not aMentor.addStudent(self):
                return False
        else:
            if existingMentor.numberOfStudents() <= existingMentor.minimumNumberOfStudents():
                return False
            existingMentor.removeStudent(self)
            if aMentor is not None:
                aMentor.addStudent(self)
        self._mentor = aMentor
        return True

    def delete(self):
        if self._mentor is not None:
            if self._mentor.numberOfStudents() <= 5:
                self._mentor.delete()
            else:
                placeholderMentor = self._mentor
                self._mentor = None
                placeholderMentor.removeStudent(self)

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "number:" + str(self.getNumber())
                + "]"
                + "\n  mentor = " + ("null" if self.getMentor() is None else format(id(self.getMentor()), "x")))
